content: तक्ष् €1 €5 <ab>P.</ab> (तक्षति, तक्ष्णोति, तष्ट) .²1 To chop, cut off, pare, chisel, slice, split; आत्मानं तक्षति ह्येष वनं परशुना यथा Mb; निधाय तक्ष्यते यत्र काष्टे काष्टं स उद्घनः <ls>Ak.</ls> .²2 To fashion, shape, form (out of wood <ab>&c.</ab>). .²3 To make, create in general. .²4 To wound, hurt; अन्योन्यं च शरैः क्रुद्धौ ततक्षाते परस्परम् <ls>Mb. 6. 45. 18</ls>. .²5 To invent, form in the mind. .²6 To make oneʼs own, appropriate. .²7 To cover. .²8 To peel. .²9 To make thin. --{%With%} निस् .²1 to slice out of. .²2 to form, create.
